title: Preserve hook managers and legacy Pudicus config in LeftBlock setup
description: The local installer preservation work is complete and fourteen installer regressions passed: foreign, legacy, edited and disabled hooks remain intact; configured core.hooksPath is respected by refusing replacement; managed hooks require matching content hashes; linked worktrees and minimal PATH are covered. Existing configuration stays preserved. This completed acceptance applies to the tested integration. Canonical LeftBlock installation and wider adoption are tracked separately and require their own validation.
